articles.summary: 作为一家获得联邦特许的数字资产银行，BitGo 将受单一、统一的联邦监管框架监管，从而能够提供机构对受联邦监管的受托人所期望的透明度、治理结构和监管确定性。
articles.title: BitGo 已获得美国货币监理署（OCC）的全面无条件批准，将转型为一家联邦特许的国家信托银行

articles.summary: As a federally chartered bank for digital assets, BitGo will operate under a single, uniform federal supervisory regime, enabling it to deliver the clarity, governance, and regulatory certainty institutions expect from a federally regulated fiduciary.
articles.title: BitGo Secures Full, Unconditional OCC Approval to Convert to a Federally Chartered National Trust Bank
